name: Radix Wire & Cable

about:
Radix Wire & Cable is headquartered in Glenwillow, Ohio, and has been manufacturing high-temperature wire and cable since 1944. The company began as a specialist in products for severe environments, with temperature capabilities ranging from 125°C to 1010°C.

The company designs and manufactures a broad portfolio of high-temperature wire and cable products, including the SuperLinx™ XLPE series, Sil-A-Blend® silicone cables, DuraFlex® high-temperature cables, DuraLife® fire-rated cables, and the Titan® industrial cable line. Its offerings span temperature ratings from 125°C to over 1000°C, serving applications from appliance wiring to aerospace and oil-and-gas environments. Radix also provides engineered solutions and custom cable designs for specific customer requirements.

Radix serves a diverse set of industries, including fire protection, thermal processing, appliance manufacturing, motors and industrial equipment, oil and gas, transit infrastructure, automotive and commercial vehicle, aerospace and defense, data centers, energy, and maintenance/repair/operations (MRO). Customers range from OEMs in aerospace and defense to industrial contractors and distributors.

Radix emphasizes a solution-oriented approach, positioning itself as a partner that collaborates with customers to engineer cables for extreme environments. The company highlights its 80-year history and focus on quality materials and stringent standards as differentiators.
